high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account "Batshit Australia" (@batshit_auspol). The tweet humorously comments on a situation where someone in Australia cuts down a tree on public land to improve their view from their house, only to have the local government install a sign to block that very view again.
